NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 11 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 22, 12:11 PM ET

The Chiefs are the top-projected defense on the Week 11 DraftKings main slate at 8.8 DraftKings points for $4,000, against Arizona. Broncos (8.2, $3,600) and Bears (8.0, $3,700) are next.

The Chargers return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.38 projected points per $1,000 at $3,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 22, 12:11 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 11

Chiefs, KC vs ARI ($4,000)

Chiefs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.8 DraftKings points at $4,000. That is 0.5 points clear of Broncos. The salary works out to 2.19 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 7 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Chiefs averaged 8.8 points with a simulated floor of -0.9 and a ceiling of 15.1, and it holds 7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 15.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 40.5.

Value: Chargers, LAC vs NYJ ($3,000)

Chargers projects for 7.1 DraftKings points at $3,000, which works out to 2.38 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 100,000 simulations Chargers averaged 7.2 points with a simulated floor of -0.3 and a ceiling of 15.9, and it holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Chargers are a 3-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 43.5.
